findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: When the database contains documents from multiple tenants, a caller can supply another tenant’s document ID and the new `{ documentId }` query can return it. `getDocument` still receives `ctx.tenantId`, and the previous implementation included it in the lookup, so removing this predicate introduces cross-tenant disclosure. Preserve the tenant identifier in both the function contract and query.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body:
In a shared database, requesting an ID owned by another tenant now queries only by `documentId`, allowing cross-tenant document disclosure. The exported `loadDocument` signature is also incompatible with existing three-argument callers.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache module
findings.body:
Deleting `src/cache.ts` breaks every existing consumer or test importing `readCached`, causing module-resolution failures at compile or startup time.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
